faqs.question: What exactly is a Dezinin newsletter?
faqs.answer: Each newsletter is a seasonal trend and design lookbook we put together for our partners, covering a specific product range (like SS27 Men’s Jersey or AW27 Outerwear) with imagery, print/graphic direction, and styling notes you can browse online or download as a PDF.

faqs.question: Can we request a custom design or newsletter for our brand?
faqs.answer: Yes. Use the Enquiry button on any newsletter or the contact form below to tell us about your range, and our design team will scope a tailored deck for your brand.

faqs.question: How long does a custom design request take?
faqs.answer: Turnaround depends on scope, but most seasonal decks are ready within 2–4 weeks of kickoff. We’ll give you a firm timeline once we understand your requirements.

faqs.question: How do I download or share a lookbook?
faqs.answer: Open any newsletter card and use the Download Design button to save it as a PDF named after the collection, ready to share internally or with your buyers.

faqs.question: How can I get in touch about a project?
faqs.answer: Use the contact form at the bottom of this page, or the Enquiry button inside any newsletter, and someone from our team will follow up shortly.
